prompt: A photorealistic macro and wide field photograph of a meadow full of dandelions at golden dusk light. Each dandelion has a different density of seeds — some sparse with only a few seeds remaining, some moderately full, a few extremely dense and full. The whole field has a gravitational visual pull toward fullness, but fullness itself is solitary. The composition makes this hierarchy feel inevitable and slightly uncanny. Shallow depth of field, warm golden light, photorealistic, physically plausible. No text. No labels. No numbers. No diagrams. No people.
visual_logic: Dandelions of varying seed density lean toward denser neighbors; the densest is surrounded by many but has none as full as itself — every node connects to hubs more connected than itself.
